How Marketplace Fees Affect Reseller Profit

Model percentage and fixed fees without assuming rates stay unchanged.

Marketplace fees can include a percentage of the transaction, a fixed charge, optional promotion, payment processing, category-specific rates, or other adjustments. The fee base may also differ by marketplace.

Use editable assumptions

A preset can become outdated. Enter and verify the fee rate that applies to your category, account, location, and transaction. MarginFlips does not automatically update marketplace fees.

A $100 sale with a 12% fee and a $0.30 fixed fee creates an estimated $12.30 in fees before shipping and item cost. At 16%, the same sale creates $16.30 in fees—a $4 difference in profit.

Compare assumptions with the marketplace fee and profit calculator.

Keep the estimate honest.

Fee structures and actual costs can change. Verify the rules that apply to your sale and treat every result as planning information.
